method: Read docs/dataset_sources.md and data/source_verification.json. Retained 8 previously manually verified verdicts. Fetched 23 distinct Wikipedia URLs for the remaining 55 records read-only, without keys or paid LLM calls. Compared the exact quote after whitespace normalization and, where necessary, exclusion of reference/interlanguage UI markers. Manually assessed questions and temporal context; used targeted web primary-source/dedicated-event-page checks for ambiguity and suspect chronology. verified means source-supported within this audit; Wikipedia source agreement is not independent primary-source confirmation of every event.
